message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1–1½ lb (450–680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Beef broth or water | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese, shredded | 16 oz (450 g) |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated | ½ cup |
| | Egg (to bind ricotta) | 1 large |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach, sautéed | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Caramelized onions | ½ cup |
| | Pesto sauce | ¼ cup |
| | Meatballs or sausage slices | ½ lb (225 g) |
| **Seasoning & Finishing** | Extra Parmesan for topping | ¼ cup |
| | Olive oil (for drizzling) | 1 Tbsp |
| | Fresh herbs (basil, oregano) | 1 Tbsp chopped |

**Tips:**
- Use a mix of beef and pork for richer flavor.
- If you’re using regular lasagna sheets, pre‑cook them in salted boiling water for 8–10 min, then drain and rinse with cold water.
- For a vegetarian version, replace the meat with lentils, mushrooms, or a hearty vegetable medley.
- Let the assembled lasagna rest for 10–15 min after baking to set the layers.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
